closed_findings.evidence: Independently verified all 51 protocol bindings, including actual consumed manifests and canonical counterparts. Full manifest membership matches the pinned originals; expected evaluation membership derives from those originals. Missing, changed, empty, dropped and duplicate inputs fail closed.

Native harness invokes the real Python WAV/decoded-PCM preflight, verifies nonempty canonical membership, hashes the exact Buffer submitted to the gateway and repeats preflight before its receipt. Both v2 receipts match the current protocol and canonical cohort.

All-action veto is restricted to the explicit OptionB preview contract. Legacy TIME/weather/timer/alarm/reminder and configured device-action semantics remain intact and have explicit regression fixtures.

Failed capture/control operations publish capture_error/runtime_error before the failed reply. Stream/gate cleanup is attempted, secondary cleanup failure is visible, and failed re-listen, recovery and EOF/shutdown are covered by regressions.

review_scope: Focused independent read-only closure: corrective diff, current source, tests, protocol, receipts and actual hash/cohort consistency checks.
summary: R1-R4 closed within scope. Independent human and actual Pi/microphone evidence remain mandatory pending promotion gates; architecture, model and policy are unchanged.
